checks.name: An unchanged complete request cohort matches its prepared refresh
A matching refresh publishes its prepared metadata
A matching refresh publishes real size and naming evidence
Applying metadata preserves current destination description and explicit selection
A superseding address rejects the older request cohort
A rejected cohort neither partially changes earlier rows nor consumes their prepared evidence
A superseding explicit name rejects old derived naming evidence
A superseding protected request context rejects the old response evidence
Changed batch authorization rejects the whole old request cohort
A changed source count rejects old positional identities
A source accepted after capture rejects the older advisory cohort
Duplicated result identities cannot overwrite one row twice
An out-of-range result identity is rejected before indexing current rows
An incomplete bulk result cannot be presented as a complete cohort
A complete bulk cohort may intentionally omit previously added rows
A current single-row result changes only its captured source slot
A changed-slot descriptor cannot borrow another row's prepared response
A missing changed-row result cannot silently clear request suppression
An invalid changed-slot descriptor is rejected
Result publication uses stable identities rather than result vector order
Advisory cohort validation and application never change catalog or command ownership
